summary: Cred and Duck analyze Bitcoin's breakdown from the 90-110k range as the monthly close approaches. They identify 70k as key monthly support and 90k+ as the reclaim level, with the area between being 'no man's land' without support. Duck expresses interest in using leverage if BTC drops to 60-70k as that would be 'overdone'. They discuss how altcoins have experienced a brutal bear market with most down 60-100% despite BTC at 100k, calling it the worst altcoin performance in 10 years. Both are cautious on Solana due to meme coin reputation damage, while Litecoin is viewed more favorably for ETF basket trades. The overall tone is neutral to bearish with a wait-and-see approach for better setups.
key_takeaways: BTC key levels: support at 60-70k, strength confirmation above 90k, no real support between 70-90k
Duck would consider leverage longs if BTC dumps to 60-70k as 'move would be overdone'
Altcoins experienced worst bear market in 10 years with 60-100% drawdowns while BTC held 100k
Solana has reputation damage from meme coin extraction; Litecoin preferred for ETF basket trades
If alts rally hard on BTC bounce, it would signal cycle top similar to 2017-2018 pattern
